title: Coda · two out
notes: Institutional coda for Exit Through the Gift Shop.

lines.text: The guard sees two men come from St Brendan's and checks the building plan for an entrance that could explain them.
One man is dragging the other clear of the west doors. Neither has a postcard, guidebook or receipt.
The second man gives the name already waiting in the RETURNED column.
The demolition order is still clipped under the ledger. It does not happen in this account.
The guard writes WEST DOORS beside both signatures.
Later, somebody adds EXIT THROUGH THE GIFT SHOP in another hand and leaves both names alone.
